messages:
Elena: Heads up — saw several customers report streaming reconnects after our midnight token rotation. Sessions are closing instead of resuming. cc @Jyoti @Marc
Marc: Hmm, suspect our resume auth check treats rotated tokens as entirely new sessions. If token_id != session_token_id we deny resume. :thinking_face:
Jyoti: Logs: resume attempt gets 401 then client does full reconnect. Also noticed quota double-counting on reconnect. snippet: `{"resume": {"last_event_id": "evt-123"}}`
Rob: Is this the same pattern as PLT-3421? Console shows spikes in open->close but no clear link to resume attempts in traces.
infra-bot: Incident created: PLT-3421 — streaming resume failures after token rotation. Priority: P2
Marc: Proposed fix: allow resume if token parent_session_id matches OR implement a short grace window (30s) where rotated tokens are accepted for resume. Also add telemetry tag prev_token_id on resume attempts so we can query rotations.
Elena: Grace window sounds reasonable. UX ask: console needs a "resume failures" panel and a tooltip explaining token rotation behavior for customers. Add to rollout checklist so we don't surprise users.
Jyoti: I'll add telemetry: histogram resume_latency + tag rotation=true/false and prev_token_id. Will also add unit tests for token matching edge cases.
Rob: We must avoid double-billing: when resume fails and client reconnects we currently bill both streams. Suggest emitting a billing event `replay-override` with overlap window (5s) to dedupe.
Elena: For a hotfix: flip a prod flag to treat rotated tokens as resumable for 24h while we ship proper fix. Who can ship the runtime change?
Marc: I can push a small prod flag and logic tweak today (runtime change only). Console/telemetry changes will be separate PRs.
Jyoti: I'll coordinate telemetry + tests. Will also create an aggregate dashboard: streaming.resumes.{success,fail} by rotation.
Rob: I'll draft the billing dedupe schema and make sure we don't regress meter reconciliation.
Elena: Owners: Marc (runtime fastfix + flag), Jyoti (telemetry + tests), Rob (billing dedupe). Adding to standup.
Rob: :thumbsup: Drafted doc for approach here: https://redwood.internal/docs/streaming-auth-rotation — please add review comments.
infra-bot: Deploy started by Marc — runtime/streaming v1.2.7 -> prod
Marc: Deployed patch to canary, smoke tests pass. Flag is ON in prod for rollout. Monitoring for 30m.
Elena: Thanks all — please watch the new resume failures widget and ping here if we see >1% resume failures or unexpected billing deltas.
